⌈

equal to 0x01 or the value is equal to 0x01, but either the contained payload does
NOT comply with [SWS_CM_10428] or the application error identified by the dese-
rialized ApApplicationErrorDomain.value and ApApplicationError.error-
Code is not referenced in role possibleApError by the related ClientServer-

logged (if logging is enabled for the ara::com implementation), and the Future re-
turned by the function call operator (operator()) of the respective Method class (see
[SWS_CM_00196]) shall be made ready according to [SWS_CM_10440].
